harnessRequirements: Expand includes preserving file boundaries/source hashes.
Suppress only outer BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK and ON_ERROR_STOP directives when joining the single owned transaction; preserve PL/pgSQL BEGIN blocks and nested exception/savepoint semantics.
Reapply jit=off, pg_show_plans.is_enabled=off, statement_timeout=0 after verifier-local settings as required by SEND5B; do not introduce a harness time limit.
Never fabricate APPLYING context, substitute a real release or weaken a verifier to qualify it.
Redact result/error payloads; retain only data-free file/statement/object/error code and approved bounded diagnosis.
Fresh connection catalogue/ledger/marker/LEGACY:1 rollback verification remains root-owned.
